theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (S : Set (Euclid P)) (Ss : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)), (∀ (sub : ℕ → ℕ) (z : ℕ → Euclid P) (x : Euclid P), StrictMono sub → (∀ k, z k ∈ ball (0 : Euclid P) 1 ∩ Ss (sub k)) → Tendsto z atTop (𝓝 x) → x ∈ S) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ k₀ : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ k₀, ball (0 : Euclid P) 1 ∩ Ss k ⊆ {x | ∃ z ∈ S, dist x z < ε}
